title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode7 Words for the Present

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: Summer Festival Stage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Any luck on your side, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I don't see it anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <How could it have disappeared...? What do we do...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our valuables may be safe, but not having your dancing shoes is going to be much more problematic.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We don't have time for this. Let's stop and head back to the stage. I'm just gonna have to do the whole thing in what I'm wearing now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's starting.
This is the opening song, right?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We gotta go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito, Toya.
We need you to stand by and get ready!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, got it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But where on earth could've Akito's shoes gone...?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I said forget about it.
We can't find them, so there's nothing we can do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That did startle me a little, but the show's started, and just need to stay cool for now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? Someone's calling me?
Oh, it's Ena...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it? I'm a little busy right now. Can't it wait...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Akito, did you happen to lose track of where your shoes went? You know, the really flashy ones that you bought the other day?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How did you...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm at the festival's HQ tent right now and just happened to spot your shoes here.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm not really sure how it happened, but I think one of the committee staff brought them over here by accident. That's why I called you.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ena, can you bring them to me right now? We're up pretty soon!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You are? Where are you?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The outdoor stage for the festival!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<The outdoor stage... Oh, okay.
I'll be there soon!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here you go!
I'm still surprised about what happened. Good thing these are so easy to spot.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're a lifesaver!
Thanks a bunch, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't mention it. Oh, but you owe me some cheesecake later. The most expensive one from that place on Miyamasuzaka will do nicely!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, got it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Li'l Bro, Toya! You're in this event?
I'm really looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good luck to you too, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry for making you have to deal with this too, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Dude, relax. I'm just glad you actually managed to get them back in time!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And since you did get them back, I'm expecting to see something good, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, duh.
Do you know just how much we practiced?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I know. You've been coming home completely wiped after all that practice, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you did know...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course I know, stupid. We live together, don't we?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I never thought that you'd be performing on this stage. You seem a lot better than you did back then too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Back then...?
Wait, you still remember...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito...
Why don't you try doing something like that...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Akito! Toya! You're almost up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then Mizuki and I are gonna head back. We'll be watching so don't screw up, alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You've got this, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (She actually remembered...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I'll be cheering for you too!
Go knock their socks off!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade, Mafuyu, we're back!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Welcome back.
The pros haven't started yet, it seems.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki, did you find your keychain?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, thanks to Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good.
I was starting to get worried since you two were gone for so long.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
Something else came up and well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Something else?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Never mind, forget I said that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, guess what? I just found this out, but Ena's Li'l Bro's performing in the amateur division too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena's brother?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. This is actually the first time I've seen him sing on stage for real.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, next up is the BAD DOGS!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, it's them!
song00009_off_s

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Whoa...
It's like a totally different vibe now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
They're awesome dancers too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He said that they only usually sing, but they wanted to add in a dance routine just for this event.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?
Then it's a good thing we found his shoes, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad we did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We've got a good vibe going...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not what we usually do, but we're singing and dancing pretty well so far.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (All that practice is really paying off.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(And next is my solo.
Toya's solo is right after that, so I need to give him a good lead-in...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Nailed it...!
Just stay in sync with Toya now...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: These guys are off the hook!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, they usually only sing, but it's amazing to see them dance like this too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow... That was awesome!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everything's so loud and obnoxious, but I don't entirely dislike this music...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They danced really well too.
It's how they can do that and sing as much as they did at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That was good, Akito...)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, one last round of applause for the BAD DOGS!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We did it, Akito.
The whole place went wild.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, the last part went like we planned too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we got these shoes too. They made each step feel so much lighter than normal.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank goodness you got them back...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I didn't know what I was gonna do back there...
